description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Status update about student"/>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CompanyUpdate1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CompanyUpdate2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CompanyUpdate3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DecideRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Student" name="Start internship search">

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProfile" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Write weekly status update about internship (at least 3)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate1" name="Receive status update about student (1 of 3)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyUpdate1" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate2" name="Receive status update about student (2 of 3)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyUpdate2" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate3" name="Receive status update about student (3 of 3)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyUpdate3" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideRecommendation" name="Decide whether to recommend company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendDecision" name="Recommend company?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TweetRecommendation" name="Tweet recommendation of company to friends (via Twitter)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Recommended" name="Company recommended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecommendation" name="No recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Student" targetRef="Task_EnterProfile"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProfile" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOffers" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate1" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="Task_DecideRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DecideRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendDecision" targetRef="Task_TweetRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Do not recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendDecision" targetRef="End_NoRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="End_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
